name: jobsearch
description: A job-search assistant: sweeps your mailbox and LinkedIn for replies and interview invitations, screens roles against your own compensation floors and geography, tracks every application and conversation, and drafts outreach in your voice. It sends nothing without your approval of that message, and never from a scheduled or unattended run: by default you send everything yourself.

metadata.versioningPolicy: Explicit releases; version reflects the release group's largest change (minor/patch). Bump before any sync or push — an unbumped change ships nothing and looks like a broken install. Rationale: docs/adr-009-versioning-policy.md
